results:
Joeri Adams of Belgium won the 2007 UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships men's junior race with a time of 41:18.0. The race was held on Saturday 27 January 2007 in Hooglede-Gits, Belgium.

Sources agree on the winning time and podium order, though they differ slightly on the gaps. Wikipedia's results table lists silver medalist Daniel Summerhill of the USA at + 0:00.7, and bronze medalist Jiri Polnicky of the Czech Republic at + 0:01.3. The VeloNews report instead lists Summerhill at the same time as Adams, with Polnicky at 0:01 back. The Canadian Cyclist results show Summerhill at s.t., meaning the same time.

content.text:
Joeri Adams (Belgium) won in **41:18**. Wikipedia's results table gives 41:18.0. The race was on 27 January 2007 in Hooglede-Gits, Belgium.

I only read the search result summaries and didn't open the pages. The sources disagree slightly on the gaps behind him. Wikipedia has Daniel Summerhill (USA) at +0:00.7, while VeloNews and Canadian Cyclist list him at the same time as Adams. The winning time itself isn't in dispute.
